questions.title: Build the Greeting
questions.description:
Strings in Java are immutable: every concatenation creates a NEW string object. Build a greeting from pieces. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String makeGreeting(String name)

It must return "Hello, " + name + "!".

Input Format:
One line with the name (a single token).

Output Format:
One line with the greeting.

Constraints:
1 <= name length <= 50, letters only

questions.title: Count the Vowels
questions.description:
Count how many vowels a word contains — vowels are a, e, i, o, u in both cases. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int countVowels(String s)

It must return the vowel count.

Input Format:
One line with the word.

Output Format:
One line with the number of vowels.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, letters only

questions.title: Palindrome Check
questions.description:
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Compare characters exactly (case-sensitive). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static boolean isPalindrome(String s)

It must return true when s is a palindrome. The harness prints 1 for true and 0 for false.

Input Format:
One line with the word.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000

questions.title: Frequency of a Target Character
questions.description:
Count how many times a given character appears in a word. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int countChar(String s, char target)

It must return the number of occurrences of target.

Input Format:
One line with the word and the target character.

Output Format:
One line with the occurrence count.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, target is a single letter
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length <= 1000, target is a single letter

questions.title: Reverse with StringBuilder
questions.description:
Reverse a word efficiently using a StringBuilder — appending characters from the end. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String reverseString(String s)

It must return the reversed word. Build it with a StringBuilder.

Input Format:
One line with the word.

Output Format:
One line with the reversed word.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000

questions.title: Toggle the Case
questions.description:
Flip the case of every letter: lowercase becomes uppercase and vice versa; non-letters stay unchanged. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String toggleCase(String s)

It must return the toggled string.

Input Format:
One line with the word.

Output Format:
One line with the toggled word.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000

questions.title: Username Normalizer
questions.description:
A signup form normalises usernames to lowercase, but rejects candidates shorter than 3 characters with the word SHORT. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String normalizeUsername(String raw)

If raw has length >= 3 return raw.toLowerCase(); otherwise return "SHORT".

Input Format:
One line with the raw username (a single token).

Output Format:
One line with the normalised username or SHORT.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 30

questions.title: Hashtag Generator
questions.description:
A social app turns a sentence into a hashtag: remove the spaces, capitalise the first letter of every word (lowercase the rest) and prefix a #. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String makeHashtag(String sentence)

Words are separated by single spaces; return the hashtag.

Input Format:
One line with the sentence (words separated by single spaces).

Output Format:
One line with the hashtag.

Constraints:
1 <= words <= 10, 1 <= word length <= 20, letters only

questions.title: Password Strength Hint
questions.description:
A login page scores passwords: base score is the length; add 2 if the password contains at least one digit; add 3 if it contains at least one uppercase letter. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int passwordScore(String pw)

It must return the score.

Input Format:
One line with the password (a single token).

Output Format:
One line with the score.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 50

questions.title: Order Code Formatter
questions.description:
A cafe's order screen prints codes as ITEM-QTY with the item name upper-cased. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String formatOrderCode(String item, int qty)

It must return item.toUpperCase() + "-" + qty.

Input Format:
One line with the item name and the quantity.

Output Format:
One line with the order code.

Constraints:
1 <= item length <= 20, 1 <= qty <= 500

questions.title: Immutable Chain Trace
questions.description:
A text pipeline concatenates two words and then replaces every occurrence of one character with another. Strings are immutable, so each step returns a NEW string that must be captured. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String transform(String s, String t, char c, char r)

It must return s.concat(t) with every c replaced by r — use the replace method.

Input Format:
One line with s, t, c and r (c and r are single letters).

Output Format:
One line with the transformed string.

Constraints:
1 <= s, t length <= 100, c and r are single letters
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= s, t length <= 100, c and r are single letters

questions.title: Anagram Check
questions.description:
A word game validates that two words are anagrams — same letters with the same counts. Compare by counting characters (sorting is forbidden here). Lowercase letters only, case-sensitive. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static boolean isAnagram(String s, String t)

It must return true when t is an anagram of s. The harness prints 1 for true and 0 for false.

Input Format:
One line with the two words.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Reverse the Word Order
questions.description:
A chat moderator reverses the order of words in flagged messages (each message keeps its words intact). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String reverseWords(String sentence)

It must return the words in reverse order joined by single spaces — build the result with a StringBuilder.

Input Format:
One line with the sentence (words separated by single spaces).

Output Format:
One line with the reversed word order.

Constraints:
1 <= words <= 20, 1 <= word length <= 30

questions.title: Longest Word Length
questions.description:
A writing coach reports the length of the longest word in a sentence. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int longestWordLength(String sentence)

It must return the length of the longest word (words are separated by single spaces).

Input Format:
One line with the sentence.

Output Format:
One line with the longest word length.

Constraints:
1 <= words <= 20, 1 <= word length <= 40

questions.title: Run-Length Compressor
questions.description:
A log shipper compresses repeated letters: each run of the same character becomes the character, followed by the run length only when the run is longer than one. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String compress(String s)

"aaabb" becomes "a3b2"; "abc" stays "abc". Build the result with a StringBuilder.

Input Format:
One line with the word (lowercase letters).

Output Format:
One line with the compressed word.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Rotate String by K
questions.description:
A ticker display left-rotates a banner by k characters: the first k characters move to the end. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String rotateString(String s, int k)

k may exceed the length — reduce it with the modulo operator first, then return s.substring(k) + s.substring(0, k).

Input Format:
One line with the word and k.

Output Format:
One line with the rotated word.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000

questions.title: First Non-Repeating Character
questions.description:
A tokenizer highlights the first character of a word that appears exactly once; when every character repeats it reports -1. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int firstUniqueChar(String s)

It must return the 0-based index of the first non-repeating character, or -1 if there is none. Count frequencies first, then scan again.

Input Format:
One line with the word (lowercase letters).

Output Format:
One line with the index, or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 100000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Title Case Formatter
questions.description:
A publishing tool converts headlines to Title Case: the first letter of every word becomes uppercase and every other letter becomes lowercase. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String titleCase(String sentence)

Words are separated by single spaces. Build the result with a StringBuilder.

Input Format:
One line with the sentence.

Output Format:
One line with the title-cased sentence.

Constraints:
1 <= words <= 20, 1 <= word length <= 30

questions.title: Longest Common Prefix
questions.description:
An autocomplete engine finds the longest prefix shared by ALL candidate words (words are compared case-sensitively). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String longestCommonPrefix(String[] words)

It must return the longest common prefix of all words (possibly the empty string — the harness prints NONE then).

Input Format:
Line 1: k. Line 2: k space-separated words.

Output Format:
One line with the longest common prefix, or NONE when it is empty.

Constraints:
1 <= k <= 100, 1 <= word length <= 100

questions.title: Run-Length Expander
questions.description:
A legacy archive stores words in run-length form: a letter followed by an optional count (1 or 2 digits; a missing count means the letter appears once). Decode it. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String expand(String s)

"a3b2" becomes "aaabb"; "abc" becomes "abc"; "a10b2c" becomes a ten times, b twice, c once. Build the result with a StringBuilder.

Input Format:
One line with the encoded word (lowercase letters and digit counts).

Output Format:
One line with the decoded word.

Constraints:
1 <= encoded length <= 100, decoded length <= 2000
